info.name: Service 9 - Security Playbook and Response Automation (Elias Ghanem)
info.description: Postman requests for the six Security Playbook and Response Automation APIs, implemented by Elias Ghanem. Run the users (5001) and playbooks (5009) services, fill in the username/password collection variables for one active account per role (ADMIN, ANALYST, AUDITOR, EMPLOYEE), then run the folders in order. Tokens, user IDs, playbook IDs and action IDs are saved automatically in collection variables. Folder 6 deletes the playbooks it created, so the collection can be run again.

item.name: 0. Setup (login)
Setup - Login as Admin

request.description: Users service login (setup only). Stores the JWT in adminToken and the user ID in adminUserId.

item.name: Setup - Login as Analyst

request.description: Users service login (setup only). Stores the JWT in analystToken and the user ID in analystUserId.

item.name: Setup - Login as Auditor

request.description: Users service login (setup only). Stores the JWT in auditorToken and the user ID in auditorUserId.

item.name: Setup - Login as Employee

request.description: Users service login (setup only). Stores the JWT in employeeToken and the user ID in employeeUserId.

item.name: 1. Create Playbook - POST /playbooks
Elias Ghanem - Create Playbook (Ransomware, Critical, 3 ordered actions)

exec: pm.test("Location header points to the playbook", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.headers.get("Location")).to.match(/^\/playbooks\/\d+$/); });

request.description: Admin creates a playbook with its initial ordered response actions in one transaction. created_by is the authenticated admin; every action starts as Pending.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Create Playbook (Phishing, High, no actions yet)

request.description: Admin creates a playbook whose actions are added later through POST /playbooks/{id}/actions.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Duplicate playbook name, different case (409)

request.description: Playbook names are unique regardless of case.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Invalid severity level (400)

request.description: Severity must be Low, Medium, High or Critical.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Missing incident category and severity (400)

request.description: name, description, incident_category and severity are required.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Server-managed created_by rejected (400)

request.description: created_by and created_at are set by the server and cannot be supplied.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Duplicate step numbers in initial actions (400)

request.description: Each initial action needs a distinct positive step_number; nothing is created.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Unauthorized - Analyst cannot create (403)

request.description: Only ADMIN can create playbooks.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Unauthorized - Auditor cannot create (403)

request.description: AUDITOR is read-only.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Missing token (401)

request.description: Every Service 9 endpoint requires a Bearer JWT.

item.name: 2. Retrieve All Playbooks - GET /playbooks
Elias Ghanem - Retrieve All Playbooks (Admin)

exec: pm.test("Response includes count and action counts", function () { const b = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(b.count).to.eql(b.playbooks.length); pm.expect(b.playbooks[0]).to.have.property("action_count"); });

request.description: Lists every playbook, newest first, with action_count and completed_count.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Retrieve All Playbooks (Analyst)

request.description: ANALYST can list playbooks.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Retrieve All Playbooks (Auditor, read-only)

request.description: AUDITOR can list playbooks.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Unauthorized - Employee cannot list (403)

request.description: EMPLOYEE has no access to Service 9.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Missing token (401)

request.description: Every Service 9 endpoint requires a Bearer JWT.

item.name: 3. Retrieve Specific Playbook - GET /playbooks/{id}
Elias Ghanem - Retrieve Specific Playbook with ordered actions (Analyst)

exec: pm.test("Actions are ordered by step number", function () { const steps = pm.response.json().playbook.actions.map(a => a.step_number); pm.expect(steps).to.eql([...steps].sort((a, b) => a - b)); });

request.description: Returns the complete playbook with its actions ordered by step_number.

request.description: AUDITOR can view a playbook.

request.description: Unknown playbook IDs return 404.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Unauthorized - Employee cannot view (403)

request.description: EMPLOYEE has no access to Service 9.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Missing token (401)

item.name: 4. Add Response Action - POST /playbooks/{id}/actions
Elias Ghanem - Add Response Action step 4 (Analyst)

request.description: ANALYST appends a step. The status always starts as Pending.

request.description: ADMIN adds the first step of the second playbook (unassigned).

request.description: Step numbers are unique within a playbook.

request.description: step_number must be a positive integer.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Missing description (400)

request.description: description and step_number are required.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Status is server-managed (400)

request.description: New actions always start as Pending; status cannot be supplied.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Add action to invalid playbook ID (404)

request.description: Unknown playbook IDs return 404.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Unauthorized - Auditor cannot add actions (403)

request.description: AUDITOR is read-only.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Unauthorized - Employee cannot add actions (403)

request.description: EMPLOYEE has no access to Service 9.

request.description: Every Service 9 endpoint requires a Bearer JWT.

item.name: 5. Update Action Status - PUT /actions/{id}/status
Elias Ghanem - Start step 2 before step 1 is Completed (409)

request.description: Steps run in order: every lower-numbered step must be Completed first.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Skip from Pending to Completed (409)

request.description: Status advances one stage at a time: Pending -> In Progress -> Completed.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - completion_date before completion (409)

request.description: completion_date may only be supplied when the action becomes Completed.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Invalid status value (400)

request.description: status must be Pending, In Progress or Completed.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Assign to Auditor rejected (400)

request.description: assigned_user_id must reference an active ADMIN or ANALYST.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Unsupported field step_number (400)

request.description: Only status, assigned_user_id and completion_date can be updated.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Update Action Status - Start step 1 (Analyst)

exec: pm.test("Step 1 is In Progress", function () { pm.expect(pm.response.json().action.status).to.eql("In Progress"); });

request.description: Step 1 has no earlier steps, so it can start.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Update Action Status - Assign step 2 to Admin

request.description: A Pending or In Progress action can be (re)assigned to an active ADMIN or ANALYST.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Future completion_date (400)

request.description: completion_date cannot be in the future.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Update Action Status - Complete step 1 (Analyst)

request.description: Completing an action records completion_date automatically.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Completed action is read-only (409)

request.description: Completed actions cannot be changed, preserving the execution history.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Update Action Status - Start step 2 (Admin)

request.description: Step 1 is Completed, so step 2 may now start.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Start step 4 while step 3 is Pending (409)

request.description: Ordering is enforced across every lower-numbered step.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Update Action Status - Complete step 2 (Admin)

request.description: Step 2 is completed in order.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Update invalid action ID (404)

request.description: Unknown action IDs return 404.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Unauthorized - Auditor cannot update status (403)

request.description: AUDITOR is read-only.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Unauthorized - Employee cannot update status (403)

request.description: EMPLOYEE has no access to Service 9.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Missing token (401)

request.description: Every Service 9 endpoint requires a Bearer JWT.

item.name: Elias Ghanem - Retrieve playbook progress after workflow (Auditor)

request.description: Shows steps 1 and 2 Completed with completion dates, steps 3 and 4 Pending.
